subject: Evaluation kickoff: Acme Corp — trial plan & scheduling
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation kickoff: Acme Corp — trial plan & scheduling

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time to chat today — great to hear more about Acme's roadmap for conversational support and the goals you outlined (reduce handle time, improve NPS on tier-1 issues, evaluate cost vs quality on a per-channel basis).

Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary workload: multi-turn chat for customer support (text only)
- Typical context length: 200-600 tokens, occasional long context up to ~2k tokens
- Target latency: p95 < 400ms for single-user interactions
- Success criteria: match baseline FCR and improve NPS by 5 pts on pilot cohort
- Security: SOC 2 / audit logs are required; you flagged encryption-at-rest and VPC for production

Next step: we'd like to run an evaluation (2-4 week trial) so you can validate latency/cost/quality on your prompt set. Proposed kickoff agenda (30-45 min):
1) Introductions & trial goals
2) Review trial plan and success criteria
3) Walkthrough of prompt set / examples you want to run
4) Technical dive on integration options and network/security
5) Agree on timeline, owners, and calendar invite

Marissa (CC) will join to cover the technical setup and trial checklist. Can you share 2-3 windows in the next week that work for you? I can send a calendar invite with the trial plan and a short prompt-set upload link.

Attaching a draft trial plan and a starter prompt set for your review — we can iterate on these during the kickoff.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
